name: iathon-fintech
description: BRASPER MVP plan: turning a WhatsApp-and-spreadsheet money-transfer flow (Brazil ⇄ Peru, PIX ⇄ PEN) into a tracked operation with e-invoicing. Expo app coming.

paragraphs: A mobile app and an AI assistant for BRASPER, a Brazil ⇄ Peru money-exchange and transfer business (PIX ⇄ PEN). Built for IATHON Perú 2026 as a working MVP on web, iOS and Android.
🎤 Presentation (7 min, in Spanish): binnicordova.github.io/iathon-fintech/presentation. Open it, press F for full screen and P for the presenter view with notes and a clock.

audience.text: A mobile app and an AI assistant for BRASPER, a Brazil ⇄ Peru money-exchange and transfer business (PIX ⇄ PEN). Built for IATHON Perú 2026 as a working MVP on web, iOS and Android.

requirements.text: What the app can do that a chat cannot: push alerts when the transfer arrives, saved accounts and one-tap repeat transfers, the camera for the proof photo, a status screen that does not need anyone to answer, biometric login later, and a record of the history.

The routine operation stops needing a human until the payment check, so the four people in sales spend their time on what needs judgement (large amounts, doubts, fraud signals) and the three in billing stop retyping.

Klarna's chief executive later said the cost-cutting had gone too far and that customers must always be able to reach a person (TechCrunch, June 2025; CX Today), while still reporting large savings from the assistant.
Since SDK 57 the Expo Go app and the Expo CLI must both be logged in to the same Expo account.
The assistant needs a Gemini API key with credits (Google AI Studio).
